name: Lebanon
shortSummary: India maintains modest diplomatic ties with Lebanon and has long contributed troops to the UN peacekeeping force (UNIFIL) in southern Lebanon, amid concern over the country's political and economic instability.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Indian troops have served in UNIFIL for decades.

majorChallenges.title: Regional instability
majorChallenges.description: Lebanon's economic crisis and regional conflict spillover constrain deeper engagement.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
